walkthroughs.title: Unirtos Walkthrough
walkthroughs.description:
Welcome to the UniRTOS VS Code Extension.

This extension provides an integrated development experience for UniRTOS

steps.title: Install UniRTOS toolchain
steps.description:
UniRTOS toolchain provides the needed packages to run the extension.
[Install UniRTOS Toolchain](command:unirtos.installToolchainCommand)

steps.title: Install Python
steps.description:
Python is needed to run build scripts.
[Install Python](command:unirtos.installPythonCommand)

media.altText: Install Python from the official website

steps.title: Install git
steps.description:
Git is needed to manage pull projects and demos.
[Install Git](command:unirtos.installGitCommand)

media.altText: Install Git from the official website

steps.title: Quectel Unirtos Driver
steps.description:
Quectel (Y) driver is needed for AT port and other Quectel ports.
[Install Driver](command:unirtos.installDriverCommand)

steps.title: UniRTOS CLI
steps.description:
Install UniRTOS CLI to do build and other commands smoothly.
[Install UniRTOS CLI](command:unirtos.installCliCommand)
